[b][size=4][font=sans-serif][color=#93c47d]Description, Requirements[/color][/font][/size][/b]
This is a bunch of seasonal portrets, so you need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]SOSCA[/url]. Also can be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30482?tab=posts]Donut's SVE Seasonal Anime Portraits[/url].

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Install via mod manager[/*]
[*]Adjust dependencies - load this mod after all others[/*]
[*]Enjoy[/*]
[/list]If it does not work, you always can install portraits manually. Just replace original pngs in the dominant mod
